purpose: Shared aggregation-arithmetic fixture. The Rust stats module (crates/mr-crabs-bench/src/stats.rs) and the Python gate driver (verification/tools/release_gate.py --self-test) both assert these exact values; drift between the two implementations fails on one side or the other.

rules.median: odd n: middle value of the sorted sample; even n: integer average (floor) of the two middle values.
rules.percentile: nearest-rank: rank = ceil(p/100 * n), 1-based; value = sorted[rank-1].
